paragraphs.title: David Confronts Saul and Proves His Innocence

answers: He went out and cried after Saul

He sent his men to attack Saul

The skirt of Saul’s robe
The entrance to the cave

answers: He bowed before him
He ran away
He shouted at him from the cave
easy.explanation: David stooped with his face to the earth and bowed himself.
easy.q: How did David behave before Saul?

His servants

He wept
He attacked David

One of David’s men
Samuel

Build the cave
